title: Prove the Wilson-loop normalization factorization
summary: Identify the exact cutoff hypotheses that make a two-loop renormalization factor split into one-loop factors, or produce a finite counterexample.
adversarial_test: Test disjoint loops whose cutoff terms share a large-field polymer; check whether the factorization is uniform in cutoff and separation.
deliverable: A quantified lemma with a proof or minimal counterexample, source citations, and exact dependency on the manuscript hypotheses.

title: Audit the permanent-to-PIT factor transfer
summary: Close or refute the factor-complexity step needed to turn the stated permanent border lower bound into a characteristic-zero hitting set.
adversarial_test: Check approximative complexity, field characteristic, threshold effectivity, and the exact hypotheses of Bürgisser's corrected theorem.
deliverable: A dependency graph with a self-contained factor lemma, precise parameters, and counterexamples to stronger variants.

title: Characterize synchronized Collatz neighbor mergers
summary: Generalize the two-point affine criterion for n and n+d and measure which merger-only residue classes survive finite-step descent.
adversarial_test: Include wraparound residues and pairs that reach the trivial cycle out of phase; compare q=0 alone against q=0,1.
deliverable: A reproducible count table with independent implementation, exact affine proof, and clear separation from a Collatz resolution.

title: Formalize the martingale transport spectral counterexample
summary: Prove in Lean that two two-asset laws have matching marginals and covariance spectra but different basket payoff prices.
adversarial_test: Check all probability weights, martingale means, characteristic polynomials, and the exact payoff value in both laws.
deliverable: A compiling Lean file with theorem statements, pinned toolchain information, and #print axioms output.

title: Formalize a bounded-face LP counterexample
summary: Give a finite rational polytope whose optimal face and coordinate behavior refute the overstrong LP reading in the release audit.
adversarial_test: Separate bounded optimal face from bounded whole feasible region and check the intended quantifiers over objective functions.
deliverable: A small rational example, paper proof, and optional Lean theorem with no sorry in claimed proved statements.

title: Audit a corpus family against its source
summary: Choose an unaudited OpenAI or Anthropic family and record its exact theorem, dependencies, available formal artifact, and unresolved gaps.
adversarial_test: Check statement strength, proof scope, axioms, counterexamples, version drift, and whether the linked artifact is the cited version.
deliverable: A source-grounded audit card with stable links and a status that distinguishes manuscript claim from replayed theorem.
